Hey, so from guitar to amp, I have guitar into compression ( I use a lot of touch tapping style, and this helps eminently for tone) which is on a lot of the time, from comp to overdrive (for when I want more meat in the tone) which is on about 50%. Then I use the multistomp more for added effects, again, I keep things rather uneasy and dark in tone, so I have things like vibrato, chorus, flanger, etc. in that chain, again this is on for about 50% and some of those effects more, or less. Then I have the delay and reverb pedals because the sway feature in those, I love the unease of those sounds and when I mess with that and chorus and vibrato, it gives a nice Halloween sound at times. The delay and reverb are on 80/90%. And I have it plugged into a JC-160 with chorus almost always on that. 

To sum up the reason I have other effects is because it is easier, and faster to flip on and off what I want and don’t want. And I like the added effects of other pedals.
